sections.h2: {{in.kwp|int}} kW solar system price in Pakistan
p: A {{in.kwp|int}} kW on-grid system, the most common size for a house with two or three ACs, was quoted at {{out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{out.price_high_rs|rs}} installed. Panels are about {{out.panels_low_rs|rs}} to {{out.panels_high_rs|rs}} of that; the inverter is usually the next biggest line, then the structure and installation. A hybrid {{in.kwp|int}} kW system with a lithium battery costs more; see the hybrid example below.

Prices in this range normally include tier-one panels, an on-grid inverter, a galvanised structure, DC and AC cabling with breakers and surge protection, earthing, installation and the net-metering application. Elevated structures, long cable runs and sales tax are often extra.

sections.h2: {{ex.0.in.kwp|int}} kW and {{ex.1.in.kwp|int}} kW solar system price
p: Smaller systems cost more per watt because the inverter, structure, labour and paperwork are spread over fewer panels: a {{ex.0.in.kwp|int}} kW system is about {{ex.0.out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{ex.0.out.price_high_rs|rs}} and a {{ex.1.in.kwp|int}} kW system about {{ex.1.out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{ex.1.out.price_high_rs|rs}}. If your roof and sanctioned load allow it, a slightly larger system is often better value per watt.

Use the solar system size calculator to find the size your bill needs before pricing it; an oversized on-grid system exports units at the buyback rate, which is far below the price you pay for imported units.

sections.h2: Solar system on installments: what the payback means
p: Banks and installers offer solar on monthly installments. The simple payback above tells you whether the installment can be lower than the bill it replaces: a {{in.kwp|int}} kW system paying back in {{out.payback_years_low|1}} to {{out.payback_years_high|1}} years at {{in.monthly_saving_rs|rs}} a month of savings leaves little room for financing cost over a short term, more over a longer one. Compare the total installment cost, not the monthly figure, with the cash price.

Payback here is simple: price divided by yearly saving. It does not include panel degradation, tariff changes, maintenance or interest. Use it to rank options, then ask for a written quote and check it with the quote checker.

mistakes: Comparing a hybrid quote with an on-grid price. The battery and hybrid inverter can add a third or more.
Pricing before sizing. Size the system from your bill first; an oversized on-grid system exports at the buyback rate.
Forgetting the extras. Elevated structure, long AC runs, civil work and sales tax are often outside the quoted price.
Reading the payback as a promise. It ignores degradation, tariff changes and financing; use it to compare options.
safety: Solar installation involves roof work and dangerous DC voltage; use a licensed electrician or registered installer and make sure DC breakers, surge protection and earthing are in the quote.

faq.q: What is the price of a {{in.kwp|int}} kW solar system in Pakistan?
faq.a: About {{out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{out.price_high_rs|rs}} installed for an on-grid system in the installer price lists and reports we checked (date under Sources), that is {{out.rs_per_w_low|rs2}} to {{out.rs_per_w_high|rs2}} per watt. A hybrid system with a battery costs more.

faq.q: How much does a {{ex.1.in.kwp|int}} kW solar system cost?
faq.a: About {{ex.1.out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{ex.1.out.price_high_rs|rs}} installed on-grid. Per watt it is dearer than a {{in.kwp|int}} kW system because the fixed parts of the job are spread over fewer panels.

faq.q: How much does a {{ex.0.in.kwp|int}} kW solar system cost?
faq.a: About {{ex.0.out.price_low_rs|rs}} to {{ex.0.out.price_high_rs|rs}} installed on-grid, around {{ex.0.out.rs_per_w_low|rs2}} to {{ex.0.out.rs_per_w_high|rs2}} per watt. Hybrid versions with a small battery cost noticeably more.

faq.q: Is a hybrid solar system worth the extra price?
faq.a: If you have loadshedding and need backup, yes: the battery replaces a UPS. If your supply is reliable and net billing is available, an on-grid system gives the shortest payback. Compare the battery kWh and warranty separately from the per-watt price.

faq.q: Can I get a solar system on installments?
faq.a: Yes, through banks and some installers. Work out the simple payback first, then compare the total of all installments with the cash price; a short-term loan can cost more per month than the bill it replaces.

faq.q: Why do prices differ so much between installers?
faq.a: Panel and inverter brands, structure type, cable sizes, protection, warranty years and what is left out of the quote. Our ranges come from secondary sources and change monthly; always get three written quotes and check them with the quote checker.
